en_title: Steam Fans Are Begging for a No-AI Filter as Steam Next Fest Is Filled With Slop
cn_title: 新品节AI泛滥，玩家求过滤功能
subtitle: 想找人做的游戏
opus_summary: Steam新品节开幕，低质量游戏似乎比往届更多，不少作品疑似使用AI生成素材。玩家呼吁增加AI内容过滤功能，也有人希望Valve收紧参展规则，减少此类作品。

paragraphs.en: Steam Next Fest, Valve's festival for indie games and demos, started earlier today, and while there are usually a ton of low-effort games included, there seems to be more than usual this time around.
paragraphs.cn: Valve面向独立游戏和试玩版举办的Steam新品节于今天早些时候开幕。虽然活动通常就有大量粗制滥造的游戏参展，但这次似乎比往常还多。

paragraphs.en: Browsing through the Next Fest, it's easy to spot plenty of games with art that looks like it was generated with a quick ChatGPT prompt. And now that Claude Opus 5.5 is out and has been at the center of the decompilation and mashup mod explosion that's been happening over the last few weeks, it's not surprising that there'd be a deluge of games that are either being promoted using AI-generated images or were just flat-out generated with AI.
paragraphs.cn: 浏览新品节页面时，很容易就能发现不少游戏的美术图看起来像是随手给ChatGPT输条提示词就生成的。如今Claude Opus 5.5已经推出，过去几周反编译和混搭Mod大量涌现，这款模型正是其中的核心工具。因此，大量游戏使用AI生成图片宣传，甚至干脆直接由AI生成，也就不足为奇了。

paragraphs.en: Unsurprisingly, there are a lot of Steam fans who aren't exactly excited about having to dig through these AI games to find human-made material, with one user straight up begging Steam to filter out the slop. In a post on the Steam subreddit, user ScalesGhost wrote : "I've been looking over the Next Fest, and I really enjoy the Discovery Queue feature, I just wish I could personalize it a bit more. Specifically, I would like the ability to filter out all games that have AI-Generated content in them (after all, steam already requires you to disclose it), and also I'd like to exclude certain tags, e.g. Incremental Games."
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，许多Steam玩家并不乐意为了找到人类创作的作品，而在这些AI游戏里翻来找去。一位用户甚至直接恳求Steam过滤掉这些垃圾内容。用户ScalesGhost在Reddit的Steam板块发帖写道：「我最近一直在逛新品节，也很喜欢探索队列功能，只是希望它能让我多做些个性化设置。具体来说，我希望能过滤掉所有含有AI生成内容的游戏（毕竟Steam已经要求开发者披露这些内容了），另外也希望能排除某些标签，比如增量游戏。」

paragraphs.en: Steam already has a robust tagging system, so this kind of filter wouldn't be a huge lift to implement, but Valve did cut down the amount of user-defined tags back in May . Iin order for that kind of filter to exist, Valve would have to add 'AI' as a tag.
paragraphs.cn: Steam已经有一套完善的标签系统，因此实现这类过滤功能并不需要花太大工夫。不过，Valve在5月确实减少了用户自定义标签的数量。要提供这样的过滤功能，Valve就得添加「AI」标签。

paragraphs.en: ScalesGhost is far from the only person who's noticed the amount of low-effort submissions in this Next Fest. In another thread about how AI has "ruined Next Fest," user EmmaBooney said, "Yeah, noticed that myself. Usually I scroll through and look for interesting games... it's all AI slop and I dont want to participate."
paragraphs.cn: 注意到本届新品节有大量粗制滥造作品参展的，远不止ScalesGhost一人。在另一篇讨论AI如何「毁了新品节」的帖子中，用户EmmaBooney表示：「是啊，我也注意到了。我通常会翻翻页面，找些有意思的游戏……现在全是AI垃圾，我都不想参与了。」

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, user aesoprowwy said, "Hopefully there is a significant drop in the engagement metrics due to the overabundance of vibe coded games being featured and steam implements some stricter guidelines for submissions."
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，用户aesoprowwy表示：「希望这些通过氛围编程做出来的游戏大量占据展示位置，会让活动的参与数据大幅下滑，促使Steam制定更严格的参展规则。」

paragraphs.en: Steam Next Fest being full of low-effort games is nothing new, however. Valve has long had a laissez-faire approach to curation on Steam, usually relying on the algorithm to boost popular games and bury the low-effort slop. And while this Next Fest does seem worse than previous events, most people are probably better off ignoring the event for a couple of days until the popular demos naturally rise to the top and most of the shovelware gets buried.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Steam新品节充斥着粗制滥造的游戏，早已不是什么新鲜事。Valve长期以来对Steam的内容筛选都采取放任态度，通常依靠算法推荐热门游戏，让那些敷衍制作的垃圾作品沉底。虽然本届新品节的情况看起来确实比往届更糟，但对大多数人来说，或许最好先等上几天，暂时别管这场活动，等热门试玩版自然排到前面，大部分滥竽充数的游戏沉底后再看。

paragraphs.en: But this comes at a time when AI in game development is getting more common by the day. Just last week Epic delayed its upcoming Star Wars shooter in order to pursue an "AI-first" direction. Epic's CEO also bragged on Twitter last week about how the company has vibe coded the Epic Games Store launcher . Even Capcom seems to have embraced AI, using it as part of its REX program, which will reportedly help it continue to improve the RE Engine that has been used in some of the best games of the year, like Resident Evil: Requiem and Pragmata .
paragraphs.cn: 而与此同时，AI在游戏开发中的应用正日益普遍。就在上周，Epic为了转向「AI优先」的方向，推迟了旗下即将推出的《星球大战》射击游戏。Epic的首席执行官上周还在X上夸耀，公司通过氛围编程开发了Epic Games商城启动器。就连卡普空似乎也已拥抱AI，将其用于REX计划。据报道，该计划将帮助卡普空持续改进RE引擎，《生化危机：安魂曲》和《识质存在》等年度最佳游戏之列的作品都使用了这款引擎。
